definitions: To be in a situation where one must choose between two equally undesirable options.
To be faced with a difficult choice between two things, both of which are unpleasant or problematic.
examples: She was on the horns of a dilemma, unable to decide whether to take the lower-paying job she loved or the higher-paying job she disliked.
The company found itself on the horns of a dilemma: either lay off employees or face bankruptcy.
He was on the horns of a dilemma, having to choose between betraying his friend or breaking his promise.
lemma: be on the horns of a dilemma
synonyms: between a rock and a hard place
source: be on the horns of a dilemma
